result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations for the rotating fluid ellipsoid: partial derivatives of the logarithm of the potential with respect to elliptic-type coordinates, series expansions of the potential in terms of auxiliary functions f_n(ρ), and integrals of the form ∫ ds/((s+ρ)√(s+1)).

methods.what: Closed-form evaluation of the auxiliary integral f(ρ)
Result of the integral as a logarithm
Introduction of new variables α, ρ from the semi-axes
Logarithmic derivatives of ρ and α with respect to the axes
Binomial expansion of (ρ-α)^{-1/2} in powers of α
Potential constant of the ellipsoid expressed as elliptic integral and power series in α with coefficients f_{2n}(ρ)
Definition of the family f_n by repeated differentiation
